name: AFNI pRF
summary: Fits a population receptive field (pRF) model to BOLD fMRI with AFNI 3dNLfim (Conv_PRF, simplex) given a visual stimulus image, and outputs the pRF parameter bucket, fitted signal and polar magnitude and phase maps.
description: Demeans and scales the BOLD within an AFNI automask, then fits AFNI's convolved Gaussian pRF model (Conv_PRF, SPM canonical HRF) voxel-wise with 3dNLfim using a random grid search followed by simplex optimisation, with the stimulus aperture images as AFNI_MODEL_PRF_STIM_DSET. Polar magnitude and phase are derived from the fitted x and y centres. Use it for retinotopic mapping experiments with a known stimulus aperture sequence. The HRF reference is generated for a fixed 1.5 s TR, and the brain mask used is computed with 3dAutomask rather than taken from the mask input.

inputs.description: Retinotopy BOLD run (the BOLD image is used; events, sbref and physio files are not used).
Stimulus aperture image sequence matching the BOLD time points, used as the pRF stimulus dataset.
Brain mask. Not used by the current code (3dAutomask of the BOLD is used instead).

outputs.description: Folder with the 3dNLfim pRF parameter bucket (Buck.PRF.nii.gz), fitted time series (snfit.PRF.nii.gz), polar magnitude and phase maps, and intermediate mean, automask and demeaned BOLD images.
